image.alt: An unlabelled plate of Acheulean stone tools: broad cleavers with straight transverse cutting edges beside pear-shaped handaxes, drawn against a dark background.

options.text: The chopper chops the meat, the handaxe's point digs the tubers, the scraper's edge cleans the hide, and the cleaver's straight edge splits the bone.
The handaxe's point splits the bone, the cleaver digs the tubers, the chopper scrapes the hide, and the scraper chops the meat.
The cleaver, the biggest blade, chops the meat, the handaxe splits the bone, the scraper digs the tubers, and the chopper scrapes the hide.
The shapes are accidents of the stone. Any of the four tools could have done any of the four jobs.
